entities.title: The IO interface and its screens
entities.summary: show(screen) resolves with the raw key that answers it; Screen is a union of 42 kinds, each with the data it shows.
consumers: src/main.ts, which paints each screen with src/ui/screens.ts and reads a key
worker/scores.ts, which answers each screen with the next logged key
The tests and the parity harness
guarantees: Every screen of a reign goes through show, including those the original moved on by itself, whose key the engine ignores
Keys are raw: "y", "Y", "1", "Enter", " " and the like; the engine alone decides what they mean
SCREEN_KINDS lists every kind, in GDD §7's order
Each screen carries the state as it is when shown
entities.compatibility: A new or removed kind needs a painter in src/ui/screens.ts and a sample in test/samples.ts; the layout tests fail until both exist.

entities.title: A reign's key log
entities.summary: The keys that answered each screen of a reign, in order, one per show: with the seed, all a replay needs.
consumers: src/main.ts, which logs every key it returns to the engine
worker/scores.ts, which replays the log through POST /api/score
guarantees: Exactly one key per screen shown, from the welcome screen to the final report
The same seed and log always replay to the same reign
entities.compatibility: Any change to the rules, the data, the order of screens or the order of draws changes what a log replays to. Reigns already on the table are not replayed again; a reign in progress during a deploy may be refused.

entities.title: The parity snapshot
entities.summary: snapshot(state) in RULES' own terms, which the parity harness compares with the baseline's after every screen.
consumers: The parity harness, kept outside this repository by the verify role
guarantees: Exactly the fields RULES names: pop, str, status, ally, treasury, costs, swiss, presidentStrength, month, threshold, revolutionStrength, plotPause, helicopter, loanEast, loanWest, requestUsed, decisionUsed, newsUsed, alive, escaped and rng

sources.symbol: snapshot has exactly the parity shape, in RULES' terms
